title: UX26 follow-up: complete T13 source navigation, return and panel-close with a fresh keyboard actor
body:
## Outcome
T13 (UX7, keyboard-only) is attempted to completion with a fresh isolated actor: open a source from the evidence panel, return to the journey, and close the inline evidence panel.

## Delivery
Status: Ready — not dispatched. Lane per #23: OpenAI/OpenClaw verification (a prompt is prepared; it is not running until it records a claim here).
Priority: P1 (the only first-round task with no completed attempt)
Refs #26 (closed), #9, #27.

## Why this exists
The first synthetic round (#26) attempted T13 once, at `d3f54e8` (run `ux26-loki-20261107`): partial / `blocked_environment`. The actor activated two publisher links, but the driver observed only the original page, so source navigation/return and inline panel-close were never exercised. The 7 November follow-up did not rerun T13. T05 later exercised a publisher visit and return against labelled local fictional source pages, which shows the runner can now intercept them. That does not complete T13.

Evidence: `research/synthetic-ux/runs/ux26-reconciled-20261108/original/t13-actor.md`, `original/summary.md` and the README "What remains open" item 1, merged in #48 (`2bcf5d8`).

This is an unfinished attempt, not an observed product failure. Nothing here implies a product defect.

## Acceptance
- Pin the exact build (current `main` or a named later head) and record runner, browser and version, viewport, theme and zoom.
- Fresh isolated actor with only the registered T13 profile and brief, starting URL and input constraints. No facilitator mappings, expected outcomes or prior discussion; disclose any priming.
- Exercise the real keyboard path: source link → publisher page (the local labelled fictional pages) → return to the journey → close the inline panel. Preserve raw traces and screenshots under a new run directory.
- Record the outcome per the evaluator guide: completed, partial or blocked, with reasons. File any observed problem as its own deduplicated finding and link it to #27.
- Separate verifier review of the record.

## Exclusions
Screen-reader announcements, the remaining actual-200% zoom coverage and component-level accessibility stay in #9. Continuity (#45) is separate.
